question_text: Which areas of the venue had the most crowd activity? Rank them by their average crowd size.
answer_text:
For hour_utc between 2025-12-08T00:00:00Z and 2025-12-09T00:00:00Z, ranked by average crowd size: 
1) KeynoteHall_Stage — 57.3975; 2) ExpoFloor_MainAisle — 49.35666666666667; 3) FoodCourt_North — 23.069583333333334; 4) DemoBooth_NVIDIA — 15.515; 5) DemoBooth_Intel — 10.648333333333333.

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(:Camera)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(l:Location)
WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
WITH l.name AS area,
     sum(toFloat(ch.avg_hc) * coalesce(ch.event_count, 0)) AS weighted_hc,
     sum(coalesce(ch.event_count, 0)) AS samples,
     max(ch.peak_hc) AS peak_hc
WITH area,
     CASE WHEN samples > 0 THEN weighted_hc / toFloat(samples) ELSE 0.0 END AS average_crowd_size,
     peak_hc,
     samples
RETURN area AS location, average_crowd_size, peak_hc AS peak_crowd_size, samples AS total_crowd_samples
ORDER BY average_crowd_size DESC, location ASC
